━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ### Top 10 News Items 1. **Tesla FSD (Supervised) fleet passes 8.4 billion cumulative miles: 28 February, 2026, 11:57 PM PST, Teslarati** Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised) system has now exceeded 8.4 billion miles driven, as updated on the company's safety page, highlighting the rapid accumulation of real-world data for neural network training. This milestone matters for Tesla's autonomy ambitions, as it approaches Elon Musk's estimated 10 billion mile threshold to handle rare edge cases effectively, potentially accelerating regulatory approval for unsupervised driving. For the industry, it underscores how data volume drives AI advancements in self-driving tech, giving Tesla a competitive edge over rivals with smaller datasets. Source: https://www.teslarati.com/tesla-fsd-supervised-fleet-passes-8-4-billion-cumulative-miles/

This development is significant for Tesla's business as it opens new markets in the Middle East, where regulatory frameworks are adapting to autonomous tech, potentially boosting adoption and sales. For customers, it means more diverse real-world data to refine FSD, improving reliability in varied driving conditions like desert environments. Source: https://www.teslarati.com/tesla-global-fsd-testing-abu-dhabi/
3. **Tesla Rebrands Autopilot Features in New 2026.2.9 Software Update: 28 February, 2026, 9:18 PM PST, TeslaNorth.com** Tesla's latest software update renames "Navigate on Autopilot" to "Navigate on Autosteer" and updates hardware references like the FSD Computer, signaling a shift in branding for driver-assistance features. This matters for the technology as it clarifies supervised autonomy to users and regulators, reducing confusion amid scrutiny over self-driving claims. For customers, the rebranding could improve user experience by aligning terminology with actual capabilities, while hinting at future unsupervised evolutions. This is important for customers as it provides practical guidance to maximize vehicle longevity and performance, addressing common concerns about degradation. For Tesla's business, it reinforces the ecosystem of home charging solutions, encouraging Wall Connector sales amid growing EV adoption. Source: https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/tesla-shares-new-battery-care-tips-warns-against-relying-on-superchargers-daily/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=tesla-shares-new-battery-care-tips-warns-against-relying-on-superchargers-daily
